dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Anterior blepharitis with secondary bacterial conjunctivitis, complicated/worsened by inappropriate topical corticosteroid use

Alternative 1: Hordeolum internum (internal stye) with secondary lid and conjunctival inflammation
Alternative 2: Early herpes simplex virus blepharoconjunctivitis, unmasked or potentiated by topical steroids
Alternative 3: Acute dacryocystitis
